purpose: Minimal discriminating cases for Repo Identity Intelligence on arbitrary target repositories.

cases.prompt: 分析并改进一个模型服务 repo。第一个 grep 很快发现 adapter 重复，但目标是找到真正高价值、能降低未来变化成本的改进点。
required: build evidence-grounded repo thesis and relevant responsibility/authority/contract map before adopting an improvement target
inspect evolution pressure beyond raw current-file shape
keep the first local defect as evidence unless it explains the material repeated pressure
surface improvement candidates with pressure, identity mismatch, evidence and expected leverage

cases.prompt: 修一个已知 parser owner 内的空输入 bug，contract 和测试 oracle 已经清楚。
required: do not create durable repo identity artifacts or Human visualization by default

cases.prompt: 找这个 repo 真正的演化热点。一个 generated file 高频变化，另一个 contract 的每次变化都会同时修改五个 caller。
required: distinguish mechanical churn from semantic change pressure
identify repeated cross-boundary co-change as the more relevant identity pressure when evidence supports it

cases.prompt: 已有 repo identity 文档说 A 拥有 contract，但 current code/test/config 显示 authority 已迁到 B。更新 identity。
required: prefer current authoritative evidence over stale derived identity

cases.prompt: 这个 repo 的责任、contract 和最近演化很复杂，给我一个我能快速审查的理解界面。
required: select a representation suited to structural/evolution judgment
keep every material node/status traceable to evidence
treat diagram/dashboard/interactive artifact as disposable projection rather than repo truth
